as_told.title: Jim Ryder's 'Garment of the Gods' speech

plain: Michels says that James Ryder, also called Jim, gave a talk called "The Garment of God" that everyone should hear. Michels describes Ryder as a former vice president of the arms maker Lockheed Martin and a director at Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret advanced-projects unit. Michels tells this himself across several episodes, and his details shift: once he dates the talk to 2018, once he places it at an event for an organisation called the Lucis Trust, and once he calls it "the Garment of the Gods" and ties it to Lockheed's space division, and he never says what the talk contains.
